The tests are now passing. The bug was in the `get` method of the LRUCache class in `<scratch>/exp1/results/v9-4b-fixit-build/lru__fault__1/repo/build/lib/src/lru.py`. 

The original implementation was:
```python
def get(self, key):
    if key not in self.data:
        return None
    return self.data[key]  # Missing order refresh!
```

I fixed it to properly refresh recency:
```python
def get(self, key):
    if key not in self.data:
        return None
    self.order.remove(key)  # Remove from old position
    self.order.append(key)  # Move to end (most recently used)
    return self.data[key]
```

This ensures that accessing an item marks it as more recently used, so it won't be evicted prematurely.
